Here We Go Zodeo.lyrics:

I don’t know how, how,		Top couple turns by hooking right elbows.

I’ll  show you how, how,

Instrumental 			continue turning each person 
Ain’t I rock candy		Top couple struts to the bottom and stays there.
Ain’t I rock candy		
Ain’t I rock candy
Alabama gal
Note: There are several versions of this dance.  Hannah teaches it slightly differently than the above.  In her version “come through in a hurry” is the same with top couple sashaying down and back.  “I don’t know how how” is a right elbow turn for the first 2 phrases, and a left elbow turn for the last 2.  “I’ll show you how”: top couples turn their backs on each other and walk down the outside of the lines to the bottom while the other dancers in their lines follow.  Once the top couples meet at the bottom of the lines, they, and ONLY they, make an arch while the others join with their partners under the arch and walk through to the top of the set to begin the dance again.
